# Harnesses

Airtight installs into 18 harnesses. Install with:

```bash
npx airtight install                      # detects what you have
npx airtight install --providers=cursor   # or name them
```

Confidence is recorded per harness rather than implied. It matters: a skill that silently fails to load looks exactly like a skill that found nothing.

## Convention

Follows the common `<dir>/skills/<name>/` layout; nothing harness-specific is known. These ship plain markdown and no hooks, because a frontmatter key a loader rejects breaks the whole skill while one it ignores costs nothing.

| Harness | Directory | Command | Agents | Edit hook |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Google Antigravity | `.agent` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| DeepSeek Harness | `.dsh` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Pi | `.pi` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Qoder | `.qoder` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Rovo Dev | `.rovodev` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Trae | `.trae` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Trae China | `.trae-cn` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Veto | `.veto` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Mistral Vibe | `.vibe` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |
| Kiro | `.kiro` | `/airtight` | inline fallback | no hook surface |

Every harness ships inline fallbacks for both sub-agents, including the ones that support sub-agents natively, because a user can decline them and the role still has to be runnable.
